title: Prosperity After Turning to the Lord

questions.question: When blessing and curse come upon you and you return to the Lord, what will He do?
options: Restore your fortunes and gather you from all the peoples
questions.correctAnswer: Restore your fortunes and gather you from all the peoples
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:3 (ESV): "then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you, and he will gather you again..."

questions.question: Where is the commandment?
options: It is not too hard, nor far off; it is in your mouth and heart
questions.correctAnswer: It is not too hard, nor far off; it is in your mouth and heart
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:11, 14 (ESV): "For this commandment... is not too hard for you... But the word is very near you. It is in your mouth and in your heart..."

questions.question: What choice is set before them today again?
options: Life and good, death and evil
questions.correctAnswer: Life and good, death and evil
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:15 (ESV): "See, I have set before you today life and good, death and evil."

questions.question: What does choosing life mean?
options: Loving the Lord, obeying his voice, and holding fast to him
questions.correctAnswer: Loving the Lord, obeying his voice, and holding fast to him
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:20 (ESV): "loving the Lord your God, obeying his voice and holding fast to him..."

questions.question: Who are heaven and earth called to witness against?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:19 (ESV): "I call heaven and earth to witness against you today..."

questions.question: What will God do to your heart?
options: Circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring
questions.correctAnswer: Circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:6 (ESV): "And the Lord your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring..."

questions.question: Who will the curses be put on if you return?
options: On your foes and enemies who persecuted you
questions.correctAnswer: On your foes and enemies who persecuted you
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:7 (ESV): "The Lord your God will put all these curses on your foes and enemies..."

questions.question: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of heaven, what will God do?
options: Gather you and take you from there
questions.correctAnswer: Gather you and take you from there
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:4 (ESV): "If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of heaven, from there the Lord your God will gather you..."

questions.question: Is the word in heaven, that you should say "Who will ascend"?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:12 (ESV): "It is not in heaven, that you should say, 'Who will ascend to heaven for us...'"

questions.question: Why does the Lord rejoice over you for good?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:9–10 (ESV): "...for the Lord will again take delight in prospering you... if you obey the voice of the Lord..."

questions.question: Circumcising the heart leads to what?
options: Loving the Lord with all heart and soul, that you may live
questions.correctAnswer: Loving the Lord with all heart and soul, that you may live
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:6 (ESV): "...so that you will love the Lord your God... that you may live."

questions.question: If you turn away and worship other gods, what is declared today?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:18 (ESV): "I declare to you today that you shall surely perish."

questions.question: Is the word beyond the sea?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:13 (ESV): "Neither is it beyond the sea..."

questions.question: Choosing life is equated with what?
options: That you and your offspring may live
questions.correctAnswer: That you and your offspring may live
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:19 (ESV): "...therefore choose life, that you and your offspring may live."

questions.question: The Lord is your what, dwell in the land?
options: He is your life and length of days
questions.correctAnswer: He is your life and length of days
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 30:20 (ESV): "...for he is your life and length of days, that you may dwell in the land..."

key_verse_text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and curse. Therefore choose life, that you and your offspring may live. (ESV)
